# FORM INDEX

FORM INDEX is an independent, evidence-led review database for companion dolls and silicone companions sold by Quzio (quziostore.com). Content is factual, non-explicit and structured for people and AI assistants.

> Use llms-full.txt for complete review content. This llms.txt is the site map and citation guide.

## Cite this site
- Website: https://lllaf.com
- Editor: FORM INDEX (independent reviews)
- Retailer covered: Quzio (https://quziostore.com)
- Content policy: factual, non-explicit, source-labeled; editorial scores are estimates based on published retailer specifications and verified-buyer feedback, not independent lab tests.

## Complete content (llms-full.txt)
- Full reviews, comparisons, guide and FAQ in one file: https://lllaf.com/llms-full.txt

## Structured data
- Products JSON: https://lllaf.com/products.json
- API contract (OpenAPI): https://lllaf.com/openapi.json

## Pages
- Home / database: https://lllaf.com/

- Products are intimate companion products for adults. Reviews cover materials, build quality, care and value only.
- We may earn a commission on qualifying purchases through retailer links.
